After the launch of Battle for Azeroths patch 8.0.1, the Pit of Saron experienced a large amount of bugs, documented in the list below. Most notably, the slave NPCs could use the appearance, quotes or flavor text from other, unrelated NPCs, and bosses from other instances could spawn inside the Pit. The issues were fixed with the July 24th hotfix.

as he appeared in life.]] Pirate-King Zem'lan is the tyrannical master of the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun, which he rules over with his crew of the eternal damned. Ages ago, when the port was threatened by sethrak, Zem'lan cursed his crew into undead monsters and forced them to serve him for eternity.
Pillaging Canoes are boats located across the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Pirate Hats can spawn in various locations around the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun, with a roughly 15-minute respawn timer. Interacting with one grants the Thirst for Adventure buff for 10 minutes.

The Pinnacle of Domination is the highest point in the Sanctum of Domination, very close to the rift between the Maw and Azeroth. The players and their allies—Bolvar, Thrall, and Jaina—travel here to confront Sylvanas Windrunner. During the encounter, Sylvanas gradually rips apart the structures surrounding the pinnacle until the second stage of the fight, at which point she escapes in banshee form and the Jailer sends out chains from the sanctum to grab onto Oribos. Jaina creates a portal to let the party pursue Sylvanas and the Jailer, and the fight continues on the Edge of the Abyss.

Plainstriders are tallstriders that are native to Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. They are colored brown. Often, they are hunted for their meat and feathers by the tauren in the area.

in Naxxramas.]] Plague-dogs (also known as zombie dogs) are a form of abomination that are seemingly fashioned entirely out of animal parts. They are one of the newer creations of the Scourge, and originally only a single one was found stalking the corridors of the dreaded Naxxramas. Others were later added in Wrath of the Lich King.

Pixel is a goblin located at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She makes a living delivering supplies around the world, and is currently delivering a load of Warsong Saw Blades. However, she won't part with the blades without some payment.

The Plaguewood is a large area directly south of Stratholme and stretching all the way to Terrordale within the Eastern Plaguelands. It is heavily occupied by the Scourge and contains large amounts of infrastructure, including ziggurats and slaughterhouses. Despite (or perhaps because of) the prevalence of the Scourge, representatives of the Scarlet Crusade routinely patrol the road leading to and from Stratholme. They attack any undead that they encounter — as well as any other travelers that these fanatics chance upon. All those journeying along the forest's road should be on the lookout for them, as they present as much of a danger as the ravening Scourge.
Plague Beasts are plague eruptors found in Naxxramas. In the version, they're bog beasts instead.
__NOTOC__ Plagued Ghouls are ghouls found in the Outer Ring of Naxxramas.
Pizznukle is a goblin leather armor vendor located in a small camp west of Lushwater Oasis in the Horde-aligned territory of the Barrens.
Plagueheart Ring is ring for warlocks. It is part of the Plagueheart Raiment armor set.

__NOTOC__ Plague Spreaders are ghouls found at Raven Hill in Duskwood. Three spawn at the border to Stranglethorn Vale if Private Merle escapes the Rebel Camp alive after finishing Patrol Schedules, usually killing him as he tries to flee into Duskwood.

The Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave (also called the Scarlet Lands), often shortened to Scarlet Enclave, is the name of the starting area for all death knight players in World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King.
Plaguewolt is a potent ingested poison. It is a rare and murderous substance created by the Forsaken.

The Plain of Echoes is located in the northeastern area of the Storm Peaks, just to the north of Camp Tunka'lo, southwest and directly above the entrance of the Howling Hollow, and to the east of the Terrace of the Makers. The Temple of Life is situated in its center.

The Forsaken plague tank (also called a plague vat) is a mobile device with tanks of sludge and two huge sprayers, used to spread the new plague in places like Halgrind. They are called both "Plague Tanks" and "plague tanks of sludge" in the same quest, so 'tank' likely refers to a container and not a vehicle. They may also be called Chemical Wagons.

Plagued Insects can spawn out of the Supply Crates in Stratholme if they have no loot. Occasionally, they will glitch and spawn even if the box wasn't opened. These too can appear at one of the gates, and in Icecrown Citadel.

Plagued Maggots are critters spawned out of Supply Crates in Stratholme. They also appear as you try to pass one of the gates in Stratholme. Sometimes, they will glitch and spawn without a box being opened.

The Plagueworks is an area inside the west side of Icecrown Citadel, connected to the rest of the instance by the Spire surrounding the Frozen Throne in the middle level of the zone. The Plagueworks is a laboratory for creation of potions, vials and containers of the Plague of Undeath and blight slimes. It is also the factory where several Abominations and horrific scourge creations are made. Professor Putricide is the leader of the Plagueworks. In order to access his lab, adventurers must first turn the Gas Release Valve and the Ooze Release Valve. The two valves however, are guarded by two fleshbeasts: Festergut and Rotface. A central theme of the Plagueworks seems to be the green liquid p
Plagueborn Horror are plague eruptors found in the Pit of Saron. They can be found moving several parts of abominations to Krick and Ick.

Plagued Residents are just what the name suggests - civilians across Azeroth who have succumbed to the plague and lost their sanity. During the Zombie Infestation world event, these infected people began wandering around low level areas, attacking any living player or NPC nearby. The infection apparently can make residents insane even if they haven't become Scourge... yet. They come from all walks of life, just like every other walking dead.
.]] Plague Scientists are undead gnomes found in the Plagueworks of Icecrown Citadel.

The Plain of Thieves is a grassy flatland found between the Imperial Granary and the Gilding Stream in south-central Valley of the Four Winds, north of the Yan-Zhe River from the Winds' Edge. It's here hawks and sprites have been taking grains they stole from the Imperial Granary.

The Plains of Serenity are a large, tranquil field located in to the west of Embaari Village. Herds of Silverpelt talbuk and flocks of Silverwing kaliri are common to these plains. A small camp of draenei trappers is located near the main road.
Plagued Zombies are summoned by Precious in Icecrown Citadel.
__NOTOC__ Plague Treants are corrupted treant creeps that can be encountered in the Felwood tileset. In the single-player campaigns, they appear as members of the Corrupted Ancients.

Plains Travelers are tauren civilians captured by the Burning Legion during the Demon Invasions. They are encaged at the Kor'kron meat camp in the Northern Barrens and saving them as an Horde adventurer would improve the score of defense against the Legion. Considering the fate of other Captured Civilians, they were probably meant to be executed or sacrificed by the demons.
Plagued Imps are imps that appear in the Antoran Wastes. They previously appeared during the Legion Invasion event.
Plaguemonger Pustulus is an abomination located in Eastern Plaguelands accompanied by blighthounds. He was killed by the priest champions of the Conclave who traveled to the Light's Hope Chapel.
Plaguemaw is a skeletal bird of prey located aboard the Naglfar in Maw of Souls while the world quest Maw of Souls: From Hell's Mouth is available. Odyn seeks his death.
Plague Sprayers are plague spreaders located in Kolramas in Zul'Drak.
Plague Disseminators are plague spreaders that float above the Fungal Vale in the Eastern Plaguelands. The cultists in the area operate them using Plague Disseminator Control Runes.
Plagueridden Tricksters are imps attacking the Shrine of Aviana on Mount Hyjal during the Defense of Aviana scenario.
Plague Imps are red imps located in Malorne's Nightmare and on the Wandering Isle. Yellow version of them also participated in the War of the Ancients fighting in the region known as Azshara.
Plainsland Cheetahs are cheetahs found across Northern Barrens and in north-west Southern Barrens. They spawn underneath trees, and Cheetah Cub have a chance to appear alongside them.
Pixxy is a goblin located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran. She and Shnivel are emptying their bank accounts because they are afraid of the newly-appeared Argus.
Plague-Tipped Arrow is an object found at the Cove of Nashal in Stormheim.
Pitlord Argamemm was an annihilan located in Azsuna under the command of Balnazzar. He was killed when the Knights of the Silver Hand arrived to find out if there was a lead on Balnazzar.

Plaguebringers deal with the logistics of deploying the plague, and as such consider themselves to be slightly more practical than the average apothecary. They are typically affiliated with the Royal Apothecary Society of the Forsaken, and the Cult of the Damned of the Scourge.
Pitmaster Rudi was a sea giant who used vrykul as battle pets. He was killed by the Valarjar champions in Azsuna.
Plainswalker Gronn was a gronn located in that was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons to find missing scouts that had entered gronn lands.

Plague Ravagers are corrupted water elementals found in Lake Mereldar in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Plaguemaster Rancel is an undead that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. His poisons helped shape the Witchwood, and as indicated by his dialogue, he currently appears to be working on developing a new plague.
Plagued Proto-Whelps are proto-dragon whelps located at the Ember Clutch in Howling Fjord.
Pitter-Patter is a Restoration shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Tidewalker and Deep Waters traits.
Plain Hat Box is sold for by Habdash in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
Plagued Dryads are Nightmare-corrupted dryads located in Val'sharah.
Planeswalker is a Destruction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Devourer of Life trait.

The plague of corrupted blood or great plague was a disease that broke out in the Zandalari Empire during the final era of the Council of Tribes, after a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer. The plague tore through the empire, killed thousands of trolls, and began one of the most terrifying periods in Zandalar's history. It became too risky for mortals to handle the dead, and golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial. It was also deemed that the bodies of the plague victims, too polluted for proper burial, would instead be burned and kept in special urns. It is believed that the Soulflayer's touch may still linger within Kings' Rest where the urns are
The Plains of Tojek is a field in western Nazmir, near the border of Vol'dun. It is named after the direhorn, Tojek. The ground is split open with :Azerite.

Plague Deviser Marileth is a prominent necromancer of the House of Plagues. He was a close confidant of Margrave Stradama but was driven insane by the fallout of his house's destruction and mistakenly believes adventurers to be his apprentice. Marileth serves as a quest giver in the Maldraxxus storyline and is one of the soulbinds available to adventurers of the Necrolord Covenant.
Plague Samples were a quest objective of Plaguefall: Knee Deep In It during the alpha. Its role was replaced by Poxedskin Sample during the beta.

Plaguefang is a darkhound located at the Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands. It fought alongside Nathanos Marris when he was attacked by the Argent Crusade, and the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde. Plaguefang and Blight-Howl charged at Tyrande Whisperwind when she appeared, but the hounds were quickly struck and killed by her starfall spell.

Plague-Ridden Survivors are skeletons and necromancers who survived the destruction of the House of Plagues and now wander around the Blighted Scar and the entrance to Plague Watch in Maldraxxus. __NOTOC__
Plague Watchers are Maldraxxi gladiators located at Plague Watch in Maldraxxus.

Plague Inventors are necromancers found near the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at Plague Watch in Maldraxxus. Some are seen pouring ingredients into the pool. In addition, three Plague Inventors can be found working alongside Plague Deviser Marileth in the Covenant Sanctum version of the Seat of the Primus.
The Plagueborne Shoulderguards drop from Margrave Stradama in Plaguefall.
Planned Execution is a conduit for subtlety rogues. It drops from Surgeon Stitchflesh in the Necrotic Wake, Shriekwing in Castle Nathria, and Lihuvim in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Plague Samples are looted from Unbroken Plague Samples at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.
Plague Barrels are located at Mord'rethar: The Death Gate in Icecrown. They're friendly when the Collaborator's Robes are worn during Secrets in Shadows.
The Pitted Finger-Bone is left behind when infusing the Finger-Bone Trophy of Battle into the Heart Forge.
Plague Bombadiers are orcs located on the Horde Airship in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
Plaguelings are beetles summoned by Ivus the Decayed in Darkshore.
Plaguebringer's Cowl is looted from Deathguard Equipment Cache.
The Planes of Torment lie between the Tremaculum and Gorgoa: River of Souls in northwestern Maw.
Plagueborn Slime is rewarded from Slime, Anyone? in Maldraxxus. __NOTOC__
Piles of Plague Refuse are located in the Blighted Scar in Maldraxxus. Plaguedoused Remnants can be seen scavenging from them.
Plaguedoused Remnants are slime giants located in the Blighted Scar in Maldraxxus. Many can be seen scavenging from piles of Plague Refuse. __NOTOC__

__NOTOC__ Plaguey is a slime initially found crawling in a circle around Plague Deviser Marileth at Marileth's laboratory in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It later accompanies Marileth and Kevin in the defense of the Seat of the Primus during In Death We Are Truly Tested and The Door to the Unknown. After completion of The Door to the Unknown, Koa can be seen riding Plaguey around the inside the Seat. Finally, in the Covenant Sanctum version of the Seat, Plaguey can be found crawling around near Marileth and his other slimes in the fortress' northwestern laboratory. The Plaguefall Wards are two enormous slime giants that appear alongside Margrave Stradama in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus during Fit For a Margrave.
Plains Mammoths are mammoths located in the Plain of Echoes in the Storm Peaks.
The Plague Watch is one of the only surviving areas of the House of Plagues where they continue experimenting in order to rebuild their house. It is overseen by Foul-Tongue Cyrlix.
__NOTOC__ Plaguerot Tauralus is a tauralus mount sold by Su Zettai in the Seat of the Primus for after reaching 23 Renown (Shadowlands) with the Necrolord Covenant.
